openwrt_wiki.untertitel: High Power 802.11n Mini Router including hardware watchdog, passive 12-18v (NON 802.3af) POE support, dual Ethernet Ports
openwrt_wiki.flash_layout: mtd0 u-boot 0x40000; mtd1 u-boot-env 0x40000; mtd2 custom 0x140000; mtd3 kernel 0x100000; mtd4 rootfs 0x600000; mtd5 rootfs_data 0x3c0000; mtd6 inactive 0x700000; mtd7 ART 0x40000 (erasesize 0x40000)
openwrt_wiki.installation: OEM installation using the TFTP method: ap51-flash eth0 <factory.bin>, dann OM2P an eth0 anschließen und einschalten
openwrt_wiki.luci_upgrade: There is a bug in LuCI which currently prevents us to upgrade via the web interface
openwrt_wiki.basic_configuration: Plug a lan cable to the left connector, telnet 192.168.1.1
openwrt_wiki.interfaces: By default, the lan interface is mapped to eth0 and the wan interface to eth1, which works but doesn't match the labelling on the case.
openwrt_wiki.failsafe: Pushing the button for factory reset does not switch the device to failsafe mode.
openwrt_wiki.buttons: There is only one tiny button for factory reset, but it doesn't seem to be supported by OpenWrt.
openwrt_wiki.fotos_modell: Model Number: OM2P 802.11g/n 150mbps Access Point with External Antenna
openwrt_wiki.gehaeuse_oeffnen: 1. Gently remove the front 2 rubber feet (farthest from the rear ports). 2. Remove the 2 screws. 3. Carefully lift the front of the lid (not more than about 5 mm), then slide forward (away from the rear ports).
openwrt_wiki.serial: This is a 3.3v serial port; baudrate 115200, flowcontrol none, parity none, databits 8. With the ethernet jacks in front of you, the pinout (von oben): RXD, TXD, GND, VCC; darunter Power | LAN1 LAN2 | Ant
openwrt_wiki.notes: OM2Pv2 is also supported via these above install instructions, however upon sysupgrade without preserving configuration to 21, from 19.07 the wan and lan ports are swapped. For OM2P V2, flash using the ethernet port closest to the power input and after flash use the other port to access the Web GUI.

openwrt_git_ath79.titel: ath79: Add support for OpenMesh OM2P v1
device_specifications: 16 MB of SPI NOR flash - 2x 7 MB available; but one of the 7 MB regions is the recovery image
TTL pins are on board (arrow points to VCC, then follows: GND, TX, RX)
eth0: 18-24V passive POE (mode B), used as WAN interface
eth1: builtin switch port 4, used as LAN interface
openwrt_git_ath79.mtdparts: The device itself requires the mtdparts from the uboot arguments to properly boot the flashed image and to support dual-boot (primary + recovery image); legacy mtd name ar7240-nor0
openwrt_git_ath79.flashing: ap51-flash; oder initramfs per U-Boot-TFTP über serielle Konsole (tftpboot 0c00000 ... && bootm), danach sysupgrade -n
